- [ ] Commit messages follow `type(scope): description (#issue)`
- [ ] Diagrams updated (.puml source and exported image)
- [ ] Tests updated or added (if code)
- [ ] `DECISIONS.md` updated, or "not needed" explained below
- [ ] Wiki / RF table updated, or "not needed" explained below
- [ ] Reviewer assigned (not the author)
